_doc: W3-D exterior district compiler spec — a 360x280 sandbagged motor-pool annex pocket in D12's own southern reaches (D12 bbox nominally ends y=2700, but its actual stamped footprint — watch towers, hangar, bunker, dormitory, tanks — runs from y~2136 to y~3220 between two full-width E-W highways at y=1872 and y=3232; this pocket at y=2880 sits in the clear strip east of the watch-tower cluster and west/south of the hangar/dormitory cluster, still inside the highway pair that bounds D12 north-south). Vocabulary (biome / surface / slot / role / density / palette / interact) comes from data/limezu-visual-catalog/placement-rules.json. Format: docs/EXTERIOR-COMPILER.md
